title: JJS dummy square part for battleground copy games
features:
adds a floating green square on players and humanoid's head, turns red when the player or humanoid is stunned like the jjs dummy, useful to test your combos if its escapable or not

beware the green monster

only works on certain battleground games (probably kj game or kj battlegrounds type games) that uses

workspace.Live.playername.Stuns
script:
local liveFolder = workspace:WaitForChild("Live")
local FLOAT_HEIGHT = 3
local function spawnthing(character)
	if not character:IsA("Model") then return end
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head")
	if not humanoid or not head then return end
	if character:FindFirstChild("StunIndicator") then return end
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Name = "StunIndicator"
	part.Size = Vector3.new(0.6,0.6,0.6)
	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	part.Shape = Enum.PartType.Block
	part.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)
	part.Parent = character
	part.Orientation = Vector3.new(0, 0, 90)
	local function update()
		if not head.Parent then return end
		part.Position = head.Position + Vector3.new(0, head.Size.Y/2 + FLOAT_HEIGHT, 0)
		local stunsFolder = character:FindFirstChild("Stuns")
		if stunsFolder and #stunsFolder:GetChildren() > 0 then
			part.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
		else
			part.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)
		end
	end
	game:GetService("RunService").RenderStepped:Connect(update)
	local stunsFolder = character:FindFirstChild("Stuns")
	if stunsFolder then
		stunsFolder.ChildAdded:Connect(update)
		stunsFolder.ChildRemoved:Connect(update)
	end
end
for _, character in pairs(liveFolder:GetChildren()) do
	spawnthing(character)
end
liveFolder.ChildAdded:Connect(function(character)
	task.wait(0.5)
	spawnthing(character)
end)
